The '''Blaster Buster''' was a small and highly specialized niche [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrower]] produced by [[Oriolanis Defense Systems/Legends|Oriolanis Defense Systems]].

The Blaster buster was a palm sized [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrower]] designed to incapacitate an attackers [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] rather than to kill.<ref name="GFT" /> Containing only a four round magazine, the weapon could be fired in the general direction of a target, the special [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsor]] driven [[Slug/Legends|rounds]] seeking out the ionized particles that clung to recently fired [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]].<ref name="GFT" /><ref name="TNEGTWT">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> So long as the target was in the general area, as well as in direct line of sight, the round would seek out the blaster.<ref name="GFT" />
